name.description: The name of the mailgraph service.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the mailgraph daemon.

rrd_dir.description: Directory where RRD data files are stored.

boot_start.description: Whether to start the daemon at boot time.

mail_log.description: Path to the mail log file to monitor.

ignore_localhost.description: Whether to ignore localhost mail traffic.

extra_options.description: Additional command-line options for the mailgraph daemon.

http_user.description: User account that owns the RRD data directory.

http_group.description: Group account that owns the RRD data directory.
